modules.title: Foundations & Precision
modules.description: Refine the technical art of a clean, balanced and precise salon-ready service.

lessons.title: Advanced Nail Preparation
lessons.overview: Refine the prep process so the surface is clean, balanced and ready for more polished product work.
learningObjectives: Support long wear and clean finish
lessons.content: Masterclass technique begins with a more deliberate prep process. Students should work with balance, intention and control rather than speed.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Review the nail plate. 2. Make a careful surface plan. 3. Clean and assess the finish before product.

assignment.title: Prep precision notes
assignment.instructions: Describe how the prep routine changes when you want a longer-lasting, cleaner result.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A clear prep strategy for more polished work.

knowledgeCheck.question: Why is precision more important in the masterclass level?
options: It reduces the need for review
It supports cleaner, more controlled results
It makes each service the same
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Precision supports balanced prep and better technical outcomes.

lessons.safetyNote: Always work with product and tool instructions. Do not work over broken skin, bleeding or suspected infection.

lessons.title: Hygiene at Masterclass Level
lessons.overview: Build a more disciplined hygiene routine so the service remains professional, safe and consistent.
lessons.content: At masterclass level, professionalism is visible in routine. A clean, measured setup supports every technical decision that follows.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Prepare the station. 2. Reset tools. 3. Confirm the work stage before moving on.

assignment.title: Hygiene routine plan
assignment.instructions: Outline the sequence you will use to maintain a tidy and professional station from start to finish.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A stronger, more reliable hygiene workflow.

knowledgeCheck.question: Why does hygiene matter even more in advanced training?
options: It supports safe work and consistent quality
It reduces the number of lessons
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Consistency and professionalism begin with a controlled, clean workstation.

lessons.safetyNote: Follow local salon policies, product instructions, and public-health standards at all times. Do not treat or diagnose skin conditions.

lessons.title: Cuticle Respect & Control
lessons.overview: Work around the cuticle area with a careful approach that supports better structure and less stress on the surrounding skin.
lessons.content: Masterclass learners should understand that clean work is not forceful work. Good control around the cuticle line requires attention and restraint.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Inspect the cuticle edge. 2. Use gentle movement. 3. Reassess the skin before continuing.

assignment.title: Cuticle control reflection
assignment.instructions: Describe how you would keep the cuticle area neat and controlled without harming the surrounding skin.
assignment.expectedOutcome: Improved technical control around the skin edge.

knowledgeCheck.question: What is the best approach around the cuticle area?
options: Work aggressively to remove excess skin
Stay gentle and controlled with awareness of the nail fold
Apply product directly to the fold
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Gentle, controlled handling supports a cleaner finish and reduces risk.

lessons.safetyNote: Never work over open wounds, bleeding or suspected infection. Refer concerns appropriately and do not diagnose.

lessons.title: Natural Shape Assessment
lessons.overview: Assess the client or model nail shape carefully before choosing a more advanced silhouette.
lessons.content: The masterclass level requires more awareness of natural structure, because better results come from adapting technique to the nail rather than forcing an ideal.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Check the nail line. 2. Review shape and curvature. 3. Adjust technique to match the natural structure.

assignment.title: Shape matching exercise
assignment.instructions: Identify which silhouettes fit each nail structure and explain the reason for your choice.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A more informed approach to shaping.

knowledgeCheck.question: Why should shaping follow the natural nail structure?
options: It keeps the finish balanced and respectful of the nail
It reduces the need for product
It makes all nails the same
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Natural structure should guide what is possible and what should be adjusted.

lessons.safetyNote: If the nail feels damaged or sensitive, stop and refer appropriately. Do not provide medical treatment or diagnose client conditions.

lessons.title: Mastering the Product Ratio
lessons.overview: Learn how the amount and proportion of product can affect the final masterclass finish and client comfort.
lessons.content: Masterclass outcomes depend on clean visual balance and measured technique. Product ratio is one of the clearest indicators of control.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Check the amount used. 2. Adjust for nail shape. 3. Review the finish before continuing.

assignment.title: Product ratio review
assignment.instructions: Review one product setup and note how the amount, placement and finish changed as you worked.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A practical understanding of balanced product use.

knowledgeCheck.question: What is the main benefit of correct product ratio?
options: It improves balance, comfort and finish
It removes the need for cleanup
It ensures the same amount on every nail
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Proper ratio supports cleaner product work and a more professional result.

lessons.safetyNote: Use only the recommended amount for the system and the nail condition. Do not work over compromised skin or inflammation.

modules.title: Technique & Application
modules.description: Build greater precision in application, placement and finishing for a more polished, controlled result.

lessons.title: Balanced Product Placement
lessons.overview: Place product in a more deliberate way to support structure, comfort and clean visual proportion.
lessons.content: Even placement is crucial in advanced technique. Good placement reduces heavy spots and gives a more elegant, clean finish.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Check the nail balance. 2. Place product in a measured flow. 3. Review the shape before final finishing.
commonMistakes: High concentration at the stress point

assignment.title: Placement quality review
assignment.instructions: Practice balancing the product across the nail and note what you adjusted to keep the shape clean.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A more controlled application routine.

knowledgeCheck.question: Why does balanced placement matter?
options: It improves finish quality and comfort
It makes the product harder to remove
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Balanced placement leads to a cleaner, stronger visual result.

lessons.safetyNote: Follow product instructions and avoid placing product on damaged or inflamed skin. If discomfort occurs, stop and reassess.

lessons.title: Advanced Finishing Techniques
lessons.overview: Polish the finish with a stronger sense of edge control, detail and client-ready quality.
lessons.content: Finish quality often separates a good result from a polished result. The attention to detail at this stage is what gives the service a more professional feel.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Review the surface. 2. Confirm clean edges. 3. Finalise the finish with controlled attention.

assignment.title: Finish assessment
assignment.instructions: Create a short finish checklist that covers shape, edge neatness and overall surface consistency.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A more polished and reliable finish routine.

knowledgeCheck.question: What does a final finish review check?
options: Edge control, seal quality and overall balance
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Finish review is about quality details and consistency.

lessons.safetyNote: Use product instructions and salon policy. Do not continue if the nail or surrounding skin appears compromised.

lessons.title: Working with a Consistent Rhythm
lessons.overview: Build a smooth rhythm between prep, placement and finish so the service feels controlled and professional.
lessons.content: A consistent rhythm helps reduce unnecessary corrections and makes each step feel intentional. This keeps the service calm, focused and easier to repeat.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Set a pace. 2. Keep the sequence constant. 3. Review and adjust if quality drops.

assignment.title: Rhythm plan
assignment.instructions: Create a simple service rhythm that keeps your timing calm and your technique consistent.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A repeatable, more controlled service flow.

knowledgeCheck.question: Why does a consistent rhythm matter?
options: It supports control and more predictable quality
It removes the need for final review
knowledgeCheck.explanation: A steady rhythm reduces errors and supports the quality of the finish.

lessons.safetyNote: Do not rush if the client reports discomfort or if the nail area appears compromised. Stop and assess appropriately.

lessons.title: Mastering the Client Experience
lessons.overview: Improve the quality of the entire service by combining technical skill with professional communication and comfort awareness.
lessons.content: A masterclass service is not only about the final result. It is about how the client feels throughout the service and how confidently the student manages each step.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Check in during the service. 2. Observe comfort. 3. Adjust with care and calm communication.

assignment.title: Client experience review
assignment.instructions: Note how client comfort, communication and technique all support the quality of the finish.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A more professional and client-centred service rhythm.

knowledgeCheck.question: What does the client experience include?
options: Only the beauty of the design
knowledgeCheck.explanation: The quality of the service includes both technical and client-care elements.

lessons.safetyNote: If a client reports pain, sensitivity or visible skin concerns, stop and follow the appropriate referral or salon protocol. Do not diagnose or treat.

lessons.title: Self Review and Correction
lessons.overview: Build the habit of reviewing your own work and correcting issues before they become major service problems.
lessons.content: Masterclass learners should be able to spot subtle issues before they become visible or uncomfortable. Good self-review creates smoother service outcomes.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Review the nail set. 2. Identify the small issue. 3. Correct it with minimal disruption.

assignment.title: Self-correction plan
assignment.instructions: Explain how you would correct a minor finish or placement issue without restarting the whole process.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A more nuanced troubleshooting routine.

knowledgeCheck.question: Why is self-review important in advanced work?
options: It reduces the need for product instructions
It helps catch issues before they become major problems
It makes work identical every time
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Self-review supports a higher standard of control and professional consistency.

lessons.safetyNote: Do not continue if the nail or skin condition appears compromised. Follow product and salon guidance and refer where needed.

modules.title: Salon-Ready Execution
modules.description: Move from clean technique into more polished salon-ready execution with structure and quality checks.

lessons.title: Quality Control in Practice
lessons.overview: Check each stage of the service with a quality-control mindset, not just at the end.
lessons.content: Quality control keeps the service calm, consistent and professional. It starts before product placement and continues to the final finish.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Check prep. 2. Check placement. 3. Check finish. 4. Review final quality.
commonMistakes: Waiting until the end to review

assignment.title: Quality control checklist
assignment.instructions: Write a simple quality-control checklist covering the main checkpoints in a salon-ready service.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A more methodical quality review.

knowledgeCheck.question: What does quality control check?
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Quality control is an active review from prep through to finish.

lessons.safetyNote: Work within accepted salon and public-health standards. Do not continue on compromised skin or unknown concerns.

lessons.title: Structure and Design Balance
lessons.overview: Review how structure, balance and detail create the final polished salon look.
lessons.content: Architecture and visual balance are inseparable in polished work. The most refined finishes feel deliberate and consistent from every angle.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Review structure. 2. Check shape. 3. Check visual balance. 4. Final review before finish.

assignment.title: Balance review
assignment.instructions: Identify one point where the structure or finish could look unbalanced and describe a small correction.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A clearer eye for balance and professionalism.

knowledgeCheck.question: Why is structure and balance important in a polished finish?
options: It makes the design more expensive
It improves the visual calm and professional look
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Balance supports a cleaner, more elegant finish.

lessons.safetyNote: Stay within manufacturer instructions and do not work on ill skin or other compromised conditions. Refer appropriately.

lessons.title: Client Communication During Service
lessons.overview: Use calm communication and observation to align technical progress with client comfort and confidence.
lessons.content: Professional communication helps the client understand what is happening without making the service feel rushed or uncomfortable.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Explain the next step. 2. Observe comfort. 3. Continue with calm adjustments.

assignment.title: Communication script
assignment.instructions: Draft a brief script for explaining the next service step and checking in with the client without overwhelming them.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A more professional communication approach.

knowledgeCheck.question: What should communication during a service aim to do?
options: Create calm awareness and client comfort
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Clear communication supports comfort and confidence during each stage.

lessons.safetyNote: If the client reports pain or discomfort, stop and follow appropriate salon or referral protocols. Do not diagnose or treat.

lessons.title: Troubleshooting Advanced Finish Issues
lessons.overview: Spot problems in the final surface, edge or balance and correct them with minimal disruption.
lessons.content: Advanced learners need to troubleshoot without panic. A calm adjustment strategy is usually more effective than major corrections.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Review the concern. 2. Identify the cause. 3. Correct with minimal disruption.
commonMistakes: Making a bigger fix than necessary

assignment.title: Troubleshooting scenario
assignment.instructions: Describe a small finish or balance issue and show how you would solve it without disrupting the whole service.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A calmer, more effective troubleshooting approach.

knowledgeCheck.question: What makes a good troubleshooting approach?
options: Reviewing the cause and correcting minimally
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Targeted correction is more effective and less disruptive than dramatic changes.

lessons.safetyNote: Keep adjustments within the product instructions and the client’s condition. Stop if the skin appears irritated or compromised.

lessons.title: Practical Masterclass Review
lessons.overview: Conduct a final practical review that considers preparation, finish, comfort and professionalism together.
lessons.content: A masterclass review looks at the service as a complete process, not just a single result. This helps students understand what quality really means in a polished salon service.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Review the whole service. 2. Identify the strongest parts. 3. Choose one improvement to carry forward.

assignment.title: Service review summary
assignment.instructions: Write a short review of one masterclass service and identify one technical strength and one technical area to improve.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A mature service assessment practice.

knowledgeCheck.question: What should a masterclass review include?
options: Only the steps that feel easiest
knowledgeCheck.explanation: A complete review covers both process and result.

lessons.safetyNote: Use review to support better technique and safe practice, not to treat or diagnose conditions. Follow salon and public-health rules.

modules.title: Advanced Practice
modules.description: Build stronger practical habits and more refined consistency through focused repetition.

lessons.title: Focused Practice Session
lessons.overview: Use a focused practice plan to improve one high-value skill without overloading the session.
lessons.content: Focused practice supports better technique because it reduces random effort and gives the student a clear objective.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Choose one focus point. 2. Repeat the skill with intention. 3. Review one improvement and one next step.

assignment.title: Targeted practice plan
assignment.instructions: Make a practice plan based on one technical challenge and one final review that will tell you if the improvement worked.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A clear, repeatable improvement cycle.

knowledgeCheck.question: What makes focused practice useful?
options: A clear objective and review step
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Focused practice allows more meaningful improvement than random repetition.

lessons.safetyNote: Keep practice intentional and safe. Follow all product instructions and stop if the client or model presents skin concerns.

lessons.title: Avoiding Overwork
lessons.overview: Learn when to stop, adjust and refine instead of pushing technique too far.
lessons.content: Overwork often creates tension between technique and comfort. Students need to know when a bit more attention is helpful and when enough is enough.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Observe the current work. 2. Check pressure and movement. 3. Adjust to maintain comfort and finish.
commonMistakes: Overbuilding solution after a small issue

assignment.title: Overwork reflection
assignment.instructions: Write how you would recognise when to stop refining and when to make a tiny correction instead of continuing.
assignment.expectedOutcome: More calibrated technique and better judgement.

knowledgeCheck.question: What is the key to avoiding overwork?
options: Continuing until the edge feels perfect
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Observation and restraint help prevent unnecessary pressure or damage.

lessons.safetyNote: Never continue if the nail area appears sore, inflamed or damaged. Do not diagnose or treat skin conditions.

lessons.title: Reading Small Details in Finish
lessons.overview: Develop stronger noticing skills so small finish details can be corrected before the service ends.
lessons.content: Advanced learners often improve because they notice details early. The small differences in edge, texture and finish matter when the goal is a polished salon result.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Scan the work. 2. Look for uneven detail. 3. Correct with minimal disruption.

assignment.title: Detail scan
assignment.instructions: Document the small details you would check in a final finish scan and explain how they affect the client’s impression.
assignment.expectedOutcome: Improved observation and fine detail awareness.

knowledgeCheck.question: What is the benefit of noticing small finish details?
options: It allows early correction and better polish
It means no final review is needed
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Small details are easier to correct when noticed early.

lessons.safetyNote: Use review to improve quality and protect the client. Stop if there is discomfort, irritation or skin concerns.

lessons.title: Building Technical Confidence
lessons.overview: Use repeatable, structured work to build technical confidence without sacrificing quality and care.
lessons.content: Technical confidence grows when the steps are understood and repeated. Students become more comfortable when they know what to evaluate and what to adjust.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Review the technique. 2. Repeat with intent. 3. Record one improvement for the next session.
commonMistakes: Using confidence as a reason to rush

assignment.title: Confidence log
assignment.instructions: Write a short confidence log that lists a skill you are more controlled in now and one you still want to refine.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A realistic view of technical growth.

knowledgeCheck.question: How does structure build confidence?
options: By reducing the need for practice
By giving students a clear path to review and adjust
By guaranteeing the same result each time
knowledgeCheck.explanation: A clear structure supports calm practice and higher technical confidence.

lessons.safetyNote: Confidence should never replace careful observation, product instructions, or safety awareness. Follow current salon standards.

lessons.title: Preparing for a Higher Standard
lessons.overview: Begin to prepare for deeper, more polished technique by reviewing what quality, structure and control look like day to day.
lessons.content: The masterclass student should be learning how to judge quality more carefully, not just whether a finish looks acceptable. A higher standard begins with better observation.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Review current skill. 2. Decide what is worth improving. 3. Set one next target.

assignment.title: Higher standard plan
assignment.instructions: Create a one-page plan explaining the standard you want to reach, one skill for improvement and how you will review it.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A more deliberate path toward advanced technique.

knowledgeCheck.question: What is the goal of setting a higher standard?
options: To compare with other students only
To evaluate quality more clearly and improve with intention
knowledgeCheck.explanation: A higher standard is about clearer quality criteria and more intentional improvement.

lessons.safetyNote: Higher standards should never excuse poor safety or poor client care. Follow product instructions and note any skin conditions appropriately.

modules.title: Completion & Readiness
modules.description: Confirm the masterclass standard, review key skills and prepare for advanced work with confidence.

lessons.title: Course Reflection & Growth
lessons.overview: Reflect on technical growth and identify the habits that will carry into more advanced work.
lessons.content: Masterclass reflection should be honest and specific. It should highlight the work that improved and the details that are still worth refining.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. List three technical wins. 2. Choose one focus. 3. Set a next action.

assignment.title: Growth reflection
assignment.instructions: Write a short growth reflection and identify one strength, one area to improve and one next action.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A clearer path to continued progress.

knowledgeCheck.question: Why is reflection important at this level?
options: To understand real progress and next steps
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Reflection helps students see progress and choose better next-step actions.

lessons.safetyNote: Reflection should support learning, not treatment claims. Follow product instructions and public-health rules at all times.

lessons.title: Reviewing Salon Readiness
lessons.overview: Assess whether the technical and professional habits you have built are ready for more polished client services.
lessons.content: Salon readiness is not only about skill. It also includes cleanliness, calm communication and the ability to identify when a task needs more care or a pause.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Review your service routine. 2. Check quality consistency. 3. Decide what still needs refinement.

assignment.title: Readiness review
assignment.instructions: Draft a short salon-readiness review covering hygiene, technique, communication and quality control.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A realistic evaluation of readiness to advance.

knowledgeCheck.question: What does salon readiness include?
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Readiness includes both technical quality and professional behaviour.

lessons.safetyNote: Do not continue with compromised skin conditions. Keep to local salon rules and refer concerns appropriately.

lessons.title: Safety & Observation Review
lessons.overview: Reinforce the importance of careful observation and safe decision-making in every service stage.
lessons.content: A polished service still needs careful observation. Students must know when to slow down, pause or refer rather than push through.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Check the skin and comfort. 2. Review the service area. 3. Adjust or pause when needed.

assignment.title: Observation review
assignment.instructions: List two safety observations that would warrant slowing the service or redirecting the client to appropriate care.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A stronger safety and observation framework.

knowledgeCheck.question: What should observation help students do?
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Observation supports better safety decisions and more professional care.

lessons.safetyNote: Never work over open wounds, bleeding, or suspected infection. Do not diagnose or claim medical treatment.

lessons.title: Planning the Next Technical Goal
lessons.overview: Choose a next goal that will deepen quality without creating unnecessary pressure or poor habits.
lessons.content: A strong next target is specific and connected to a clear need. The goal should support growth and be honest about what still requires work.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Pick one improvement area. 2. Specify the action. 3. Review with a clear benchmark.
commonMistakes: Trying to improve everything at once

assignment.title: Next goal plan
assignment.instructions: Set a technical goal for your next practice session and explain how you will know it is improving.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A realistic, measurable next step.

knowledgeCheck.question: What makes a good next goal?
options: It is clear, relevant and measurable
knowledgeCheck.explanation: A clear target is easier to improve and easier to assess.

lessons.safetyNote: Set realistic goals that respect product instructions and client safety. Avoid making any treatment claims.

lessons.title: Masterclass Completion Readiness
lessons.overview: Confirm that the student has the technical, professional and safety habits needed to continue into more advanced work.
lessons.content: Completion is not just about finishing a course; it is about confirming that key standards are in place and that improvement can continue without rushing or ignoring safety.
lessons.practicalWorkflow: 1. Review the service habit. 2. Check technical control. 3. Confirm next-stage readiness.

assignment.title: Readiness summary
assignment.instructions: Write a final summary describing your technical strengths, your safe practice habits and the next area you want to deepen.
assignment.expectedOutcome: A maturity-based readiness review.

knowledgeCheck.question: What does completion readiness mean?
options: The student has solid standards, safety and next steps
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Readiness means the student can continue with a clear standard of technique and safety.

lessons.safetyNote: Good readiness is grounded in professionalism, public-health compliance, product guidance and appropriate referral when skin concerns are present.
